description: Search the Enum.*, Constants.* and structure tables the in-game API uses — for example Enum.ItemQuality or the AuraData structure returned by C_UnitAuras. Searching for a member name finds the table that contains it.

flavor.description: Game client to answer for. Defaults to WOW_DEFAULT_FLAVOR, or retail.

kind.description: Restrict to one kind of table.

query.description: Type, enum, constant or member name.

name: wow_api_type_search
title: Search API enums, structures and constants
